text: DSH OpenAI OAuth 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 ChatGPT 订阅模型插件。它注册独立的模型源，并在模型设置中提供账号授权与选择界面；授权后，用户可在原有模型选择器中选择 ChatGPT Subscription。插件也集成 SIWC 会话压缩支持。适合希望在 DSH 中通过官方 Sign in with ChatGPT 使用订阅推理的用户。需要具有订阅推理权限的 ChatGPT 账号，不需要 OpenAI API Key；登录、模型目录和推理请求连接 OpenAI 服务。

DSH OpenAI OAuth adds a ChatGPT subscription model source to DSH. Authorize an account in model settings, then select ChatGPT Subscription in the existing model picker. It also integrates session compaction. A ChatGPT account with subscription inference permission is required; no API key is needed.
想用 ChatGPT 订阅额度在 DSH 里选模型对话。
DSH 能通过官方 ChatGPT 登录接入订阅模型吗？
希望把自己的 ChatGPT 账号授权给 DSH，按需切换到订阅模型。
DSH OpenAI OAuth 的功能「ChatGPT 订阅模型源」：在模型设置中授权并选择账号，再从原有模型选择器选择 ChatGPT Subscription 模型。当前会话不会自动切换。
DSH OpenAI OAuth 使用 auth.openai.com 完成授权，并连接 api.openai.com 获取模型目录和发送 Responses 推理请求；相关登录与推理数据会发送给 OpenAI 服务。

Independent community plugin; not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek. This is **not** the legacy fixed-client Codex OAuth/backend-api integration.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Features：- Continue with ChatGPT, dynamic Agent registration, persistent host identity, and verified ID Tokens.
- Account-specific verified model/reasoning metadata in **DSH's existing model selector**, without renewing authorization just to edit a local choice.
- Public Responses streaming, verified image/document input, local function tools, tool results, and compatible history replay.
- Multiple saved account/workspace registrations, explicit account selection, rotating refresh, and scoped sign-out.
- Keeps DeepSeek Account, API-key providers, other sources, and existing sessions independent. No silent billing fallback.
- Stable account/session-scoped Responses affinity for cache reuse, without sending raw session identifiers.
- No Codex CLI, API key, patched ASAR, or replacement pi-ai installation.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Compatibility：Minimum Desktop requirement: `>=0.2.0-rc.2`. Development/install helpers require Node.js **24+**. Historical native baselines are **0.2.1-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2**; current platform evidence is recorded below.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Compatibility：New release labels do not require an allowlist entry or a startup test subprocess. Loading uses the minimum floor; actual Interfaces, owner authentication and session protection decide capability. Unknown metadata and different component version strings alone do not disable a working Host. A broad loading range is not certification of every future release. See [forward compatibility](docs/forward-compatibility.md).

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Install from source：No npm publication is required or currently promised.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth.git
cd dsh-openai-oauth
npm ci
npm test

The `dsh` helper discovers the installed desktop executable and invokes its own bundled CLI; it does not install another Host. Use `DSH_APP` for a nonstandard installation. See [installation](docs/install.md) for Windows PowerShell and macOS examples.
@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Install from source：Only restart DSH after running tasks have finished. A window close may hide the application to the tray; use its normal Quit action.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Use a reviewed archive：For a clean/archive installation only. If the package is already linked to a checkout, keep it linked and use native `add -w` from the reviewed checkout instead; do not remove then install an archive over the Junction. See the [safe linked-update procedure](docs/install.md#updating-a-linked-checkout-safely).

```sh
npm run pack
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop add ./artifacts/pyh-pan-dsh-openai-oauth-0.3.9.tgz
```

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Use a reviewed archive：Do not keep the old private bundle and this bundle enabled simultaneously: they deliberately preserve the same provider/credential identity. See [migration](docs/migration.md).

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Sign in and use：1. Open **Settings → Models → ChatGPT subscription**.
2. Click **Continue with ChatGPT**, then open the official authorization link in your browser.
3. Name/approve the Agent on OpenAI's page. Finish authentication yourself; never copy tokens from another client.
4. Read the first-use notice and select **Use this account**. Signing in alone does not switch your conversation's model.
5. Select **ChatGPT Subscription** in the existing model picker. Its **Reasoning level** submenu shows only choices advertised by that model.
6. Use **Manage usage** to review the Agent, quota, limits, and access at [ChatGPT Settings → Usage](https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage).

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Sign in and use：Accounts without the granted direct-inference scope remain signed in but disabled for inference. Explicitly enable subscription inference to request consent again. Reauthorization reuses the registration; adding a different account is a separate action.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Authorization resilience (0.3.9)：Model/effort selection can use previously verified, account-scoped metadata. This disk cache never supplies authorization, context capacity or attachment capabilities. Actual preparation and native pressure compaction obtain credential-bound runtime capabilities; unknown facts still fail closed. **Refresh status** is read-only; **Update model catalog** uses the network and renews only when needed; **Renew authorization** is explicit maintenance, never an unattended install test.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Authorization resilience (0.3.9)：The macOS direct connector uses only a recognized existing DNS policy, native proxy routing and strict original-host TLS; unknown/proxy/hosts-override routes and Windows remain with Host fetch. No global network settings are changed. Advanced native plugin configuration may select `requestPolicy.transport: host` to retain Host transport.

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Authorization resilience (0.3.9)：Unconfirmed rotating-token outcomes are durably fenced, not automatically retried by the next caller. Verified grants and operation fences use credential payload schema v2: an old reader refuses them rather than ignoring their safety state. Do not hand-edit records or downgrade them to v1. An account affected by a previous unconfirmed renewal should be officially reauthorized first. See the [diagnosis, pi comparison, verification and rollout boundaries](docs/auth-resilience.md).

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Limits and security：- Models, reasoning choices and quota are account/server dependent, not an unlimited or universal model entitlement.
- Supports text, normalized images and supported documents through inline Responses input when accepted by the selected model. Local per-request limits include 20 images, 10 files, 20 MiB per file and 40 MiB total file bytes. See [attachment types, native contracts and verification boundaries](docs/attachments.md).
- Audio/video, the Files upload API and hosted MCP/tool-search are not implemented. Unknown binary formats and over-limit history fail explicitly, rather than silently dropping attachments.
- Explicit `maxTokens`/`temperature` remain rejected under this provider's conservative SIWC preview contract, not silently ignored; clear them before ordinary chat. The same provider bundle integrates [SIWC compaction and per-session coverage safety](docs/compaction.md) for compatible standard/cordis/ptc/minimal declarations, in memory without writing user presets. No separate local compatibility bundle is needed. From 0.3.7 integration follows actual Host capabilities, not an exact release. Missing/pending protect

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Development：```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run check
npm run test:package

Run these suites explicitly during development/release review; production startup and installation never spawn them just because a Host version changed. Pure tests use generated identities and mock upstreams. Native tests use an installed DSH and **temporary** credentials; they do not read your grant or spend inference quota. Real-account desktop validation is separately documented and always user-controlled.
@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Development：Source is published directly as ESM; no generated `lib/` or vendor snapshot is necessary. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Update / remove：If both the source and authorization settings disappear after a DSH upgrade, check [version compatibility troubleshooting](docs/install.md#missing-source-and-authorization-settings-after-a-dsh-upgrade) before signing in again. An incompatible bundle is skipped before its code runs.

For a linked checkout, review/pull changes, run checks, then restart DSH safely. For an archive, install the reviewed replacement using the native plugin command. To remove:

@pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth README · Update / remove：```sh
npm run dsh -- plugin --profile desktop remove @pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth
```

Removal preserves stored credentials. If you want to disconnect this Agent, sign out or manage access in ChatGPT settings first; do not delete the entire DSH profile.
